'''Faraire''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[General/Legends|General]] and a member of the [[War Trust]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
During the [[Invasion of Taris|Occupation of Taris]] in [[3642 BBY]], Faraire joined the [[Republic Strategic High Command]]'s [[War Trust]] as one of the four top military [[General/Legends|Generals]]. On Taris, Faraire and the other generals were responsible for directing the [[Republic Strategic High Command]] in their efforts to face the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and also advance the [[Project Siantide]].

[[Darth Baras]] decided to put an end to the War Trust and send [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to [[Destruction of the War Trust|eliminate]] them. Upon being confronted in his compound, Faraire unleashed a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] powered by the newly developed Siantide technology, which, as he boasted, outclassed any weapons the Empire could come up with tenfold and would force the Empire to surrender. However, the [[Sith Warrior]] reacquainted him with the reality that no technology was a match for [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by destroying the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Shocked at what he had just witnessed, Faraire made a run for it, but his escape was cut off by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Malavai Quinn]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]], who anticipated that Faraire would make an escape. Cornered, Faraire formally surrendered and asked if he was to be treated fairly as dictated by the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Warrior refused and kill him with [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|Force-choking]].
{{Endgame}}
